judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Short exclamatory shop greetings with brusque personalities ('be quick about it', 'if you have the gold') fit Nox's shopkeepers; the slightly awkward 'finest [Thing] of the [Place]' and the shop-named-after-a-group line feel like original game copy rather than an imitation, though the set is thin enough that it could be a careful pastiche.
